answer: An adversary therefore has to keep every alias continuously active for 20 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. The sparrow counter is kept in forge and falcon reveals each reset. A bond is refunded only after 20 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A farm of 1758 identities would post 2905 proofs and burn roughly 67 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
